text:
leah: Heads up — FalconBank is seeing a spike in 504s on their dedicated pool (pool-2). p95/p99 latency jumped ~3x over the last 10m. Customer is P1 and asking for mitigation. Creating this thread to coordinate owners and short-term workarounds. @kai @maria @sam please ack and call owners.

ops-bot: [ALERT] FalconBank-dedicated-pool-2 returned 504 >5% (window=7m). incident=INC-2026-0387. See runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/dedicated-504s

kai: I'll take lead on routing work. Quick check — metrics show inflight=320 (target 200) and queue length growing. Suspect queue saturation / head-of-line. Pulling logs now.

maria: FYI PR #4823 fixes a kv-cache eviction NPE that can trigger storms under high contention. Ready for review but needs sam to merge.

sam: On-call — I can review PR in ~10m. Short-term: can we shift a small pct of traffic off pool-2 to hosted-fallback while we triage? If pool-1 is healthy that buys us time. @ops-bot can we stage a 20% reroute?

ops-bot: Reroute request accepted. Command queued: /routing shift falconbank pool-2 -> hosted-fallback 20% (initiator=sam). See audit: https://redwood/audit/route-1771112222

dario: In parallel we should raise max_inflight on pool-2 to reduce head-of-line backpressure. Quick patch: 
```kubectl -n inference patch configmap pool-config --patch '{"data":{"max_inflight":"400"}}'
kubectl rollout restart deploy/pool-2
```
I'll open the infra change and coordinate with Jordan for the canary.

jordan: I'll spin a short-lived canary with the new config and route 5% to it. Will also have rollback config ready. ETA for canary + health checks: 20m. CC infra oncall. Customer expects an ETA ~2h for full resolution — we'll aim for quicker.

sam: Reviewing PR #4823 now. Left two small comments about a nil-check and a test. If maria addresses, I'll merge and trigger canary build. Also queueing a rolling restart for pool-2 nodes in 15m if reroute doesn't bring errors down.

maria: Working on the comments now, should upload patch in ~8m. Will add unit test.

kai: ack, will monitor metrics and update every 5–10m. Initial plan: 1) reroute 20% -> hosted-fallback (sam/ops-bot) 2) canary new config (jordan/dario) 3) merge PR and merge-candidate deploy (maria/sam) 4) rolling restart if errors persist (sam).

leah: Action items captured — Kai (routing monitoring + final signoff), Maria (PR fixes & deploy), Sam (review + merge + restarts), Jordan (canary + rollback readiness), Dario (infra config patch). I'll message FalconBank with a 30m status update now. :thumbsup:

kai: update 10m later — error rate dropped to 2.1% after reroute. p95 down but p99 still elevated. Continuing triage.

maria: pushed fix for comments and added test, PR updated: https://git.redwood/r/redwood/4823

sam: merged PR and kicked canary deploy. Monitoring signals now.

jordan: canary traffic 5% healthy for 6m. Promoting to 20% next if no regressions.

leah: Great work team — keep updates in this thread. I'll coordinate next customer update at +30m.
